+"""Automate release preparation."""
+
+import re
+import sys
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+VERSION_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+
+def update_version(new_version: str) -> None:
+    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r'__version__ = ".*"', f'__version__ = "{new_version}"', content)
+    VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Updated version to {new_version} in {VERSION_FILE}")
+
+def update_release_notes(new_version: str) -> None:
+    lines = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
+    
+    # Find the first version header
+    version_header_pattern = re.compile(r"^## \d+\.\d+\.\d+")
+    insert_index = -1
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if version_header_pattern.match(line):
+            insert_index = i
+            break
+    
+    if insert_index == -1:
+        print("Could not find any version header in release notes. Adding to the end.")
+        lines.append(f"\n## {new_version}\n")
+    else:
+        # Insert the new version header before the first existing version header
+        lines.insert(insert_index, f"\n## {new_version}\n")
+    
+    RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.write_text("".join(lines))
+    print(f"Added version header {new_version} to {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE}")
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print("Usage: python scripts/release.py <new_version>")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    
+    new_version = sys.argv[1]
+    update_version(new_version)
+    update_release_notes(new_version)
+    
+    # Run the add_latest_release_date script
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/add_latest_release_date.py"], check=True)
+    print("Release preparation complete!")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
